events.content:
ProductGallery now shows an image for each product. It follows the same pattern as the hero image in `app/page.tsx`: the Next.js `Image` component from `next/image`.

The change in `app/ProductGallery.tsx`:
- Imports `Image` from `next/image`.
- Renders `<Image src={product.imageUrl} alt={product.name} width={300} height={200} />` under each product name.
- Removes the TODO comments.

I didn't add `priority` like the hero image has. The Next.js 16 docs bundled with this project say it's deprecated in favor of `preload`. Gallery images further down the page load lazily by default, so they don't need either.

Checks:
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` passed (exit 0).
- `npx next build` passed (exit 0) and built both routes as static pages.

The build also added `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` to the `include` list in `tsconfig.json` on its own. And there's no `public/` folder in the repo, so `/product-1.jpg` to `/product-3.jpg` (and `/hero-image.jpg`) will return 404 until you add those files.
